svg.title: Proposed IRB / DGM recursive improvement architecture and JEV advisory role
svg.desc: A new trusted experiment controller selects parents from an exploration archive, supervises bounded sandboxed coding trials and admits candidates using independent development receipts. JEV only recommends choices. Dendrite and Ganglion place and run whole models. After search ends, frozen finalists undergo separate promotion, a single frozen final audit and human approved reversible deployment. No sealed evaluation feedback returns to search.

g.text: PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE • Research design, not a deployed integration
Freeze policy, models, limits and stop rules
Viable stepping stones may lose locally
02 BOUNDED DEVELOPMENT TRIALS • KARPATHY-STYLE LOCAL LOOP
No admin APIs, raw keys or sealed data.
Generated code cannot modify the controller.
Evaluator traffic uses separately authorized routes.
Only after search stops + campaign integrity passes
NO promotion or final-audit feedback returns to the same search campaign.
Hard gates remain outside the learned scorer.
Scope: frozen-weight agent / runtime research • whole-model distribution, not tensor or pipeline splitting • 26 Oct 2026
